content: Hello! How can I assist you today? If this is about your e-commerce order, I can help with payment verifications or provide your digital receipt.
Hi, I'm following up on my purchase from Sunday. I used Zelle to pay and want to make sure you received it.
Thank you for reaching out so promptly. I see a Zelle payment received on June 9th for $79.99 under the name Alexis Mendez. The transaction ID is ZEL897214. Is that your payment?
Yes, that's me. My email is alexis.mendez88@gmail.com, and I included the order reference 20240609-AM in the notes.

Perfect, Alexis. The order reference 20240609-AM matches our records and the payment is linked to your profile (alexis.mendez88@gmail.com). You should have received a confirmation email instantly when the payment cleared.
I got the email. Can you confirm the shipping address? I need my package quickly.
Absolutely, I can confirm your shipping address as 412 Pinecrest Ave, Unit 2B, Springfield, IL 62704. Your order is scheduled to ship today to ensure on-time delivery.
Great, that's correct. Will I get a tracking number?

Yes, once your package leaves our warehouse, a tracking number will be sent to alexis.mendez88@gmail.com within the next 2 hours. If you don't see it soon, please check your spam folder or notify us so we can resolve it without delay.
